description: A front-end HTML page implementing a database viewer interface with dynamic data loading, table rendering, and user interaction features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database to show its tables, loads tables via API.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds the HTML table with data for display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates an individual cell, handling long text and object values.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
